method: Bundled application event handlers in a Node VM with DOM, image-loading and WebGL test doubles; verifies application state, not browser rendering.
checks: The design workspace is the default, with no panorama WebGL work and origin-checked automatic height
HD mode loads only the selected full image and never initializes panorama WebGL
Persistent neighboring-room buttons move through the home in HD
All 32 style/room combinations load the intended HD image, caption and download
Native zoom, fit and extreme drags clamp correctly
Switching HD / panorama retains room and style and restores the proper controls
Rapid style changes commit only the final request
Changing browsing modes retains the editing frame and its unsaved scheme choices
Map and design notes still open and close
